prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset: landscape 16:9 promotional still of the REAL WorkDash campsite, to be displayed in a landing-page product window.

Image 1 is the authoritative edit target: an actual render of the app's campsite from its map and original tile assets. Preserve this scene very faithfully.
Images 2, 3 and 4 are the real green-haired, brown-haired and dark-haired character sprite sheets. Use one normal idle frame per sheet, never show a sheet.

Change only this: add these three small avatars in a relaxed, welcoming group beside the existing campfire. Put one just left of the fire, another to its right, and the green-haired host near the left foreground log, facing down toward the visitor. Leave a clear empty space on the near side of the fire and keep the entrance approach open. Feet must be on grass, never in the flames, on furniture, or inside one another. Characters should be about 64 pixels tall relative to this 1536x864 map, using the same sprite scale as the actual game. Normal compact pixel-game anatomy and idle poses only, no waving or exaggerated gestures.

Keep exactly the existing map's flat 2D top-down RPG style and plain green grass. Preserve the original three tents, four colored camping chairs, fire, lanterns, logs, stumps, wooden bench, wood stack, the Camping sign, paved approach and tree positions. Keep original existing colors, coarse pixels, restrained game shading, and existing tiny fire. This is a friendly gathering in the actual app, not an upgrade to its graphics. Pixel fidelity matters more than ornamental detail.

CRITICAL OUTPUT: opaque rectangular full-bleed image, scene continues sharply to ALL FOUR EDGES. Absolutely NO feathering, no fading edges, no vignette, no white or black perimeter, no page background, no transparency, no rounded corners, no frame. All feathering will be implemented separately in CSS for both dark and light themes. Do NOT bake any theme into this image.
No marketing text, headline, buttons, bubbles, labels, UI, logo or watermark. Keep only the map's existing Camping sign.
Avoid photographic or cinematic lighting, sun rays, glow halos, fog, 3D conversion, new furniture, redesigned trees, detailed grass, high-definition faces or luxury materials.
processing: WebP q86, 1672x941, 120074 bytes. No baked feathering. CSS alpha masks adapt to the page theme.
